name: Sync Labels

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'main'
    paths:
      - 'labels.yaml'
      - '.github/actions/sync_labels/**'
      - '.github/workflows/sync_labels.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: dry run
        type: boolean
        required: true
        default: false

# Do not allow multiple label sync workflows to run in parallel
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  sync-labels:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: ./.github/actions/sync_labels
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.MELTYBOT_GITHUB_AUTH_TOKEN }}

name: Sync Labels
description: Sync labels across all repositories specified in the config
inputs:
  token:
    [REDACTED] GitHub token with access to read and write labels, and list repositories in the Meltano and MeltanoLabs orgs
    required: true
  config:
    description: The path to the label sync config file
    default: labels.yaml
  dry-run:
    description: Compute label changes required, but do not apply them
    default: 'false'

runs:
  using: node16
  main: index.js

# .github repository

This repository contains config files and workflows for all repositories in the [meltano](https://github.com/meltano) GitHub org (and occasionally the [MeltanoLabs](https://github.com/MeltanoLabs) GitHub org too).

## Label Synchronization

The file [`labels.yaml`](https://github.com/meltano/.github/blob/main/labels.yaml) specifies labels which are synchronized across all repositories in the [meltano](https://github.com/meltano) and [MeltanoLabs](https://github.com/MeltanoLabs) GitHub orgs. They are updated when the file is updated on the `main` branch, or when the label sync workflow is run manually.

To add a new label, add new entry to [`labels.yaml`](https://github.com/meltano/.github/blob/main/labels.yaml) under the `labels` key:

```yaml
  - name: "label name"
    description: "label description
    color: "0075CA" #hex color
    aliases:
     - "other labels to rename"
```

To test a PR, run the ["Sync Labels" workflow](https://github.com/meltano/.github/actions/workflows/sync_labels.yml) on your branch with the "dry run" option selected.

Note that no labels will currently be deleted if they do not match the configuration.

# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please email `security@meltano.com` to report any security vulnerabilities.
We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report the next business day
and strive to send you regular updates about our progress.
If you're curious about the status of your disclosure please feel free to email us again.

ci:
  autofix_commit_msg: |
    [pre-commit.ci] auto fixes from pre-commit.ci hooks

    for more information, see https://pre-commit.ci
  autofix_prs: true
  autoupdate_commit_msg: "chore: pre-commit autoupdate"
  autoupdate_schedule: weekly

repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v6.0.0
    hooks:
      - id: trailing-whitespace
      - id: end-of-file-fixer
      - id: check-json
      - id: check-toml
      - id: check-yaml
      - id: pretty-format-json
        args: ["--autofix", "--indent=4", "--no-sort-keys"]
      - id: check-added-large-files
      - id: check-merge-conflict

  - repo: https://github.com/python-jsonschema/check-jsonschema
    rev: 0.38.2
    hooks:
      - id: check-renovate

# Number of days of inactivity before an issue becomes stale
daysUntilStale: 365

# Number of days of inactivity before a stale issue is closed
daysUntilClose: 21

# Set to true to ignore issues in a project
exemptProjects: false

# Set to true to ignore issues in a milestone
exemptMilestones: true

# Set to true to ignore issues with an assignee
exemptAssignees: true

# Issues/PRs with these labels will never be considered stale
exemptLabels:
  - evergreen

# Label to use when marking an issue as stale
staleLabel: stale

# Comment to post when marking an issue as stale
markComment: >
  This has been marked as stale because it is unassigned, and has not had
  recent activity. It will be closed after 21 days if no further activity
  occurs. If this should never go stale, please add the `evergreen` label, or
  request that it be added.

# Comment to post when closing a stale issue. Set to `false` to disable
closeComment: false
